name: dotfiles
description: The mods: auto-session-title, ado-link-bar, toast-notify. Skills and settings hooks live outside the plugin (claude/skills, claude/hooks).

linkBarEnabled.title: Link bar: enabled
linkBarEnabled.description: Show Azure DevOps links in the band above the prompt.

linkBarOrganization.title: Link bar: organization
linkBarOrganization.description: Azure DevOps organization used to link AB#1234 mentions (dev.azure.com/<organization>). Empty: AB# mentions are ignored.

linkBarPullRequests.title: Link bar: pull requests
linkBarPullRequests.description: How many of the most recently mentioned pull requests to link. 0 shows none.

linkBarWorkItems.title: Link bar: work items
linkBarWorkItems.description: How many of the most recently mentioned work items to link. 0 shows none.

toastMinTurnSeconds.title: Toast: minimum turn seconds
toastMinTurnSeconds.description: A finished turn shorter than this raises no toast. Failed turns always do.

toastMinCommandSeconds.title: Toast: minimum command seconds
toastMinCommandSeconds.description: A Bash or PowerShell command that ran at least this long raises a toast when it finishes.

toastStallSeconds.title: Toast: stall seconds
toastStallSeconds.description: A turn with no model output or tool call for this long raises a toast. 0 disables it.
